WITH media_type_averages AS (
    SELECT
        mt.Name,
        AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS average_ratio
    FROM MediaType AS mt
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS overall_average
    FROM media_type_averages
)
SELECT
    m.Name,
    m.average_ratio,
    m.average_ratio - b.overall_average AS difference
FROM media_type_averages AS m
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE m.average_ratio > b.overall_average;

SELECT MediaType.Name, COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
FROM Track
JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
WHERE Track.Bytes > 10323804
GROUP BY MediaType.Name
